messages:
ben: Kicking off TerraFlux joint perf workshop next Tue 9am PT. Goal: perf/W baseline, kernel tune windows, and an initial marketplace readiness checklist. Need owners for thermal telemetry and SI packaging. :rocket:

ashley: I can own thermal telemetry. I'll bring the heatmap scripts and the localized PID logs.

mihir: For kernel tweaks let's scope: governor/turbo settings, hugepages, irq affinity, and our new memcg swap limiter. Need to confirm kernel version matrix from TF side.

eva: TerraFlux says they can run baseline images on 4 nodes with our quantized v2 profile. They asked about prefix cache behavior — do we have a test harness for KV-cache warmup?

ben: Yes — we have a small synthetic: `runtest --kv-warmup 200 --seq 512 --profile q2` — Ashley can post the runbook.

ashley: pasted runbook link: https://internal.redwood/bench/runbooks/terraflux-q2
Code snippet for lab:
```
# run on each node
./benchctl start --model rwlm-13b-q2 --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --profile perfw
./benchctl collect --out /tmp/terraflux-$(date +%s).tar
```

mihir: On kernel side, recommend these flags: `intel_pstate=disable` (for consistent clocks), `nohz_full=1-3` on dedicated cores, and enable `kvm-intel` nested off for baremetal. We'll try stepping changes to measure perf/W delta.

sam: Who's handling marketplace listing cadence? We need a short blurb and performance table to attach for the TF marketplace entry after the joint report.

nate: I'll coordinate SI packaging and partner onboarding. Need MD5s of the images and the telemetry schema (ashley pls). Also flagging dependency on our private KMS for keys during private deployment tests.

bench-bot: bench run queued: id=bf-20240324-09, nodes=4, profile=perfw, notify=#partnerships on completion

ops-bot: FYI: lab reservation confirmed Tue 08:30-12:00 PT (deck A). Please badge in.

eva: Quick question — do we want to include an on-device quantization smoke test? TerraFlux has an NPU we could use to validate offload paths.

ben: Yes include it. Keep it short (50 samples), label as "smoke-quant". If results good, add a note for marketplace: 'validated on-device quant offload (TF NPU)'.

ashley: I'll add telemetry fields: temp_avg,temp_peak,power_draw_avg,p99_latency,throughput_watt.

sam: I'll draft marketplace blurb & press checklist. Need final perf table by Thu COB so marketing can review.

ben: Solid. Owners: telemetry=ashley, kernel=mihir, SI packaging=nate, marketplace=sam. If anyone can't do, shout now. :thermometer:

mihir: All good from infra side. I'll stage kernel patches on branch `partners/terraflux/kernel-tunes`.

ashley: Noted. I'll push runbook updates and a minimal collector: `tf-collector v0.3`.

nate: I'll request TF to sign the NDA addendum for marketplace screenshots, sharing contact: marta@terraflux.com

ben: Thanks — we'll reconvene Fri 10am PT to review raw runs and decide go/no-go for announcement.
